# Tasks Document

- [ ] 1. Rounding on node segments
  - Files: presstoshape/models/shapes.py, presstoshape/geometry/nodes.py, presstoshape/geometry/path_edit.py, tests/geometry/test_nodes.py, tests/geometry/test_path_edit.py
  - `CornerKind`, `Rounding`; `rounding: Rounding | None = None` after `corner` on MoveTo/LineTo/CubicTo; `Anchor.rounding` read by `anchors_and_edges`, written by `rebuild` (closed start on the MoveTo); `insert_node` keeps the split segment's fields via `replace`; path_edit clears it on break copies, merged join nodes and smooth/symmetric nodes, keeps it for corner, reverse, close/open, combine/split
  - Purpose: the stored data and its survival through edits (Req 1.1, 5.1–5.3)
  - _Leverage: corner flag plumbing from spec path-structure_
  - _Requirements: 1.1, 5.1, 5.2, 5.3_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec live-corners, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Python developer experienced in computational geometry | Task: Implement per design.md "Keeping roundings through edits"; tests for each keep/clear rule | Restrictions: pure Python, no Qt; positional constructors unchanged | Success: full suite green, ruff clean. Before starting set this task to [-] in tasks.md; after finishing log it with log-implementation (with artifacts) and set it to [x]._

- [ ] 2. geometry/corners.py and transforms.outline
  - Files: presstoshape/geometry/corners.py, presstoshape/geometry/transforms.py, presstoshape/geometry/nodes.py (shared de Casteljau split), tests/geometry/test_corners.py, tests/geometry/test_transforms.py
  - `has_rounding`, `rounded`, `limited`, `roundable`, `widget`, `radius_for` per design.md (tangents, cut length, limits, curve cuts by arc length, round / inverted / chamfer pieces, closed starts); `outline` rounds paths with roundings and returns the original tuple otherwise
  - Purpose: the rounded outline everything draws and measures (Req 1.2–1.5, 2.1, 2.3, 2.4)
  - _Leverage: path_edit.to_subs, nodes._is_smooth, insert_node's split_
  - _Requirements: 1.2, 1.3, 1.4, 1.5, 2.1, 2.3, 2.4_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec live-corners, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Python developer experienced in bezier geometry | Task: Implement per design.md "Rounding geometry" with the unit tests listed under Testing Strategy (arc points on the circle, tangent continuity, limits and `limited`, inverted, chamfer, curves, closed start, ends and smooth nodes ignored, degenerate angles, widget/radius_for inverse); check booleans/PathCache pick the rounded outline up through outline | Restrictions: pure, no Qt; never raise on degenerate input; no cost for paths without roundings | Success: tests green, ruff clean. Before starting set this task to [-] in tasks.md; after finishing log it with log-implementation (with artifacts) and set it to [x]._

- [ ] 3. Corner operations and Object to Path
  - Files: presstoshape/editing/operations/corners.py, presstoshape/editing/operations/__init__.py, presstoshape/editing/operations/paths.py, presstoshape/editing/queries.py, tests/editing/test_corners.py
  - `set_radius`, `set_corners`, `selected_corner_values`, registered `path.remove_corners` and `path.apply_corners`; `to_path` bakes rounded paths; `can_object_to_path` accepts them
  - Purpose: the only code that changes roundings (Req 3.4, 4.1–4.3, 5.4)
  - _Leverage: node_editing._targets pattern, _document.replace_shape_
  - _Requirements: 3.4, 4.1, 4.2, 4.3, 5.4, 5.5_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec live-corners, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Python developer familiar with the session/operations architecture | Task: Implement per design.md "Operations"; tests: only corner nodes with two sides change, undo labels, merge_key, remove with/without node selection, apply keeps id/style/place, Object to Path bakes, a boolean on a rounded path uses the rounded outline | Restrictions: reach shapes through editing/containers; plain values in | Success: tests green, ruff clean. - [ ] 4. Files: .p2s v12, SVG metadata, clipboard
  - Files: presstoshape/formats/p2s.py, presstoshape/formats/p2s_migrations.py, presstoshape/formats/svg.py, presstoshape/formats/svg_reader.py, presstoshape/formats/svg_names.py, docs/file-format.md, tests/formats/samples/v12.p2s, tests/formats/test_p2s.py, tests/formats/test_p2s_migrations.py, tests/formats/test_svg_corners.py, tests/formats/test_clipboard.py, tests/formats/test_svg_generator.py
  - `.p2s` `roundings` field (validated), version 12, no-op migration, sample, docs row; SVG writes rounded `d` + `<p2s:corners>` metadata (no nodetypes on such paths), reader restores live corners when they reproduce `d` (radii scaled by the element transform), else plain path silently
  - Purpose: live corners survive save, reopen and copy/paste (Req 6)
  - _Leverage: Composite metadata pattern in svg.py / svg_reader._composite, corner flag encoding_
  - _Requirements: 6.1, 6.2, 6.3, 6.4, 6.5_

  - _Requirements: 3.1–3.8, 4.1_
